moved: The 1st: the inner gate's opening 44 m (round 0 said 36). The line crosses the gate wall at 59°, so through a wall 20 m thick 36 m left a straight channel 21 m wide; 44 m leaves 27. The Gate and Court tees moved back (to 50 and 88 m along the line) so their drives come down short of the gate's waist.

The 4th and 5th: the cistern's north wall ran through the tower court and the 5th tee; it now stands north of the 4th green (and the water stays out of the court). The court's east wall moved 10 m west so the 4th green has room. The causeway's left side is land to the west wall, as the card's words say (rough, then the wall's foot), so water is on one side of the landing area only, and the causeway is crowned harder so it reads as a hog's back. The arcade in front of the 4th tee is piers with the middle fallen where the causeway goes through (a pier stood 12 m in front of the Rampart tee).

The 5th: the pin 11 m east so the green stops short of the tower's plinth (it ran onto it); the Tower tee 8 m back (170 yd); the tips spot just outside the court's doorway, playing through it (200 yd).

The 3rd: the tee 10 m east and the right-hand green 16 m south, so the two versions are mirror images. From the layout's tee the right-hand bold line ran into the corridor's full-height wall, and its fairway was 9 yd closer than the left's. The shared outer wall now runs straight; the full-height side walls end at 70 m (80 before); the low walls stay 8-13 m. Each leg ends in a green perched on a dais 4.5 m up (holes 2 and 3 were both level, which the height-forms rule doesn't allow twice running).

The 6th: the tower court's fallen corner is a gap with rubble (the low wall there stood 20 m in front of the tee). The tips spot is in the court's corner, 25 yd behind the back tee, as the tower stands behind it.

The 7th: the garden's west wall stops at the forecourt (it crossed the line) and the forecourt has its own walls. The alcoves are 40 m wide (at 30 m only a third of tee shots with an amateur's miss got in, from 40° off their axis) and 5 m up. The tees stand in a row at the forecourt's south end (the forward tees were 60° off the doors).
Every green falls toward the approach, 1.6-2.0%, its one feature (a tier, ridge or bowl) kept off the pin; they fell away from the player before.
The 2nd: the kick bank is 6 m over 16 m (round 0's 5 over 17 left approaches 20-30 yd long stuck on its lower half); now approaches 30-40 yd long all come back to the green. The corridor leans 3%.
Landing areas lean more, for variety: the Elbow's first leg 4% to the east, the garden's lower fairway 5%, the 9th's wall top 2.5% toward the maze (all were near level).

The 9th: the breach's steps re-spaced (the rubble 370-394 m along, a level 46 m, a step 440-460, a level to 490, a step to the green's shelf) so it reads as stepped; the wall-top fairway narrower away from where drives land (mean 31 m: the course's fairway widths had clustered at 41-58 m).
Fairways start further from the forward tees on the 2nd, 3rd and 6th (each was under 10 m from one).
open: Past real golf: relief.mjs and spread.mjs find no hole past real golf. The card's is the 2nd (dead straight between walls 60 m high), which they can't measure. Keep it as the one past real golf (noted by hand), or also push something they can measure, such as the 5th's green at the tower's foot to about 1,300 m²?

The 3rd has no tips spot: the 2nd's corridor ends 10-25 m behind its back tee. The Keystone plays the Tower tee there (as now), or a tips tee off to the side in the 2nd's corridor's end, playing over its bank?

The walk from the 3rd's right-hand green to the 4th tee is about 340 m (from the left-hand green, 70 m). Accept it, or add a passage behind the outer wall from the right leg's end to the 4th's vestibule (a walk only; nothing plays)?

The 7th: with an amateur's miss a third of tee shots hit the alcove's walls and drop at their foot (a chip from rubble). Keep it (walls on three sides is the hole), or set each green 5 m deeper into its alcove?

The 9th's numbers: the lay-up short of the rubble leaves 185-190 yd down the steps (the layout said about 165 m, 180 yd), and from the wall top a 3 wood finishes 30 yd short of the green for a long hitter, 45 for a mid one. Fine as they are?
